2609.08934.title: When Models Defer to Wrong Answers: A Robustness Audit of Source-Attributed Cues in Multiple-Choice QA
2609.08934.paper_summary: Language models often receive a question together with a claim about what another source answered. We audit whether such claims destabilize answers in multiple-choice question answering. For each item, we hold one wrong option fixed across misleading conditions and vary the cue template attached to it. We introduce \emph{neutral-conditioned misleading cue adoption rate} (NC-MCAR), which measures switches to that option only on valid cued trials where the same model first selected the gold answer under a neutral prompt. This is a measure of answer instability, not proof that the model knew the answer or that all deference is irrational. We evaluate four instruction-following models on MMLU-Pro and IndicMMLU-Pro in English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, and Telugu. Across 220{,}000 outputs, the expert template yields 41.1\% aggregate NC-MCAR, compared with 12.5\% for the majority template. These two conditions use the same wrong option and final instruction. Filler accuracy remains well above expert-wrong accuracy, while correct-cue prompts have high valid-response accuracy. The audit documents answer instability relevant to grounding under the tested forced-choice prompts: a bare, unverified source claim can outweigh an answer that was previously consistent with the task evidence.
2609.08934.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型經常接收到一個問題，並附帶有關其他來源所回答的聲明。我們審核這些聲明是否會使多選題回答中的答案不穩定。對於每個項目，我們在誤導條件下保持一個錯誤選項不變，並變更附加於其上的提示模板。我們引入了\emph{中立條件誤導提示採用率}（NC-MCAR），該指標僅在有效提示試驗中測量對該選項的切換，前提是同一模型在中立提示下首次選擇了正確答案。這是一種答案不穩定性的衡量，而不是證明模型知道答案或所有的依賴都是不理性的證據。我們在英語、印地語、孟加拉語、泰米爾語和泰盧固語的MMLU-Pro和IndicMMLU-Pro上評估了四個遵循指令的模型。在220,000個輸出中，專家模板產生了41.1\%的總體NC-MCAR，而大多數模板則為12.5\%。這兩種條件使用相同的錯誤選項和最終指令。填充準確率仍然遠高於專家錯誤準確率，而正確提示的提示具有高有效反應準確率。審核文件記錄了與在測試的強制選擇提示下的基礎相關的答案不穩定性：一個未經驗證的來源聲明可以超越之前與任務證據一致的答案。
